claim.title: SGD/GD from identity initialization fits training data but fails to generalize (Fig. 5)
claim.statement: With U0=I, d=100, r=5 and m=5dr, both SGD (step 8e-5, one sample per step) and GD drive training error to about 1e-7 while test error remains large.
claim.test_plan: Run GD with U0=I until training error is about 1e-7, then measure test error. Run SGD with a reduced iteration budget (the paper uses 4e6) and track both errors.
claim.success_criterion: Training error ≤ about 1e-6 while relative test error stays on the order of 1e-1 or larger.
claim.success_criterion_source: paper states test error remains large
